annotations.title: Get the prepaid balance and remaining allowances

description:
Get the prepaid balance and remaining allowances

Returns the account's wallet balance in EUR alongside the voice minutes and chat conversations still available in the current period. These are live counters: they fall as calls and conversations are consumed and are topped back up by a plan renewal or an add-on purchase. Use this before starting a batch campaign to confirm there is enough left to pay for it.
